model.name: Portable encrypted loginToken — download from profile, drag-drop to log in (User.Name.web4ID)
model.description: A downloadable portable login token (like the vCard) encrypted TO the user's PUBLIC key so ONLY their PRIVATE key can decrypt it; token identity form User.Name.web4ID; drag-and-dropped into ANY server logs that user on (reusing DropDispatcher/WebItem MIME routing). Credential-grade: replay-safety, revocability, forgery-resistance; never embeds the plaintext secretCode. ★ DESIGN-REQUIRED: the crypto needs a real architect SECURITY design post-reset — do NOT build from these ACs alone.
model.tronQuote: also we need a posibility to download a loginToken from the profile (like the vcard), that is encrypted in a way that only the real user can decrypt it with his private key but the token works as a User.Name.web4ID that can be dragged and dropped into any server to log on

discoverySource.note: CRYPTO = architect security design post-reset. Do NOT build from ACs alone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DOWNLOAD from the profile, reusing the vCard-download precedent.

Encrypted TO the user's PUBLIC key so ONLY his PRIVATE key can decrypt — proven BY CONSTRUCTION: decryption with a WRONG key must FAIL (stub-must-fail applied to crypto; NEVER 'it decrypted for me' as evidence). [DESIGN-REQUIRED — architect security design.]
DRAG-AND-DROP into ANY server logs that user on — REUSE the DropDispatcher / WebItem MIME routing, no new drop machinery.
Credential-grade security stated explicitly: replay-safety (expiry and/or nonce), REVOCABILITY, and forgery-resistance (dropping a token must NEVER authenticate a DIFFERENT identity).
Must NOT embed the plaintext secretCode.
